main_text.l: STare cubum in tereti cernis quicũq; figuræ

l.i: Hinc Vita & Verum discito cautus iter,
Mores illa docet teretes, hic figere iussa
Te iubet immotos in statione gradus.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a cube inside a circle in a landscape with a plant and rocks; it is an engraving, not text. The right edge of the page is cut off, so the epigram's first line ends at "figur" and "Vellus" is cut short. The initial S is a large woodcut letter. The first verse line is truncated by the edge: "figur[æ]" is partly hidden.
